video_title: Tuomas Iisalo Press Conference | Grizzlies vs. Cavaliers

quotes.speaker: Tuomas Iisalo
quotes.summary_phrase: Hendricks' major impact on the game's outcome
quotes.excerpt: Hendricks really had a major impact on the game tonight.
quotes.quote: Hendricks really had a major impact on the game tonight. He might have made the biggest plays of the whole game with his, it was at least a double block and then I think Abu took the ball from Allen in that, but just a tremendous play and it's been great to see him blossom into the player that he's only scratching the surface of what he can be.
quotes.social_post: Tuomas Iisalo praised Hendricks for his late game impact against the Cavaliers saying he made the biggest plays of the game with his double block and is only scratching the surface of what he can be.

structured.context: Coach Tuomas Iisalo discusses the impact Taylor Hendricks had on the game against the Cavaliers.

quotes.speaker: Tuomas Iisalo
quotes.summary_phrase: Hendricks' positive development and work ethic
quotes.excerpt: He's been one of the most positive, bought-in guys ever since he came in from Utah.
quotes.quote: He's been one of the most positive, bought-in guys ever since he came in from Utah. He's really I think appreciated the opportunity that he got late last season and really dove into his workouts during the summer and came in ready this season and wasn't playing early in the year and now because of injuries or foul trouble or guys needing to rest, he got his opportunity and he's used it to the maximum.
quotes.social_post: Tuomas Iisalo on Hendricks development after not playing early in the year he got his opportunity and he used it to the maximum.

structured.context: Coach Tuomas Iisalo praises Taylor Hendricks for his work ethic and development after receiving an opportunity due to injuries.

quotes.speaker: Tuomas Iisalo
quotes.summary_phrase: The team's road success and young roster's poise
quotes.excerpt: There's a ton of meaning and gratitude in the daily work and just to get to work.
quotes.quote: There's a ton of meaning and gratitude in the daily work and just to get to work with this group. The way these guys are fighting, even if we were 0-8 in this situation, this group is, I love the work with this group. From day one they've shown commitment and especially trust in each other that if we all, and I don't like that word, sacrifice because we're all thinking about the best of the team, but if everybody thinks in the team first, everybody benefits from that.
quotes.social_post: Tuomas Iisalo says he loves working with this group because from day one they have shown commitment and trust in each other.

structured.context: Coach Tuomas Iisalo reflects on the team's commitment and collective mindset during their road trip.

quotes.speaker: Tuomas Iisalo
quotes.summary_phrase: Managing late-game situations and missed free throws
quotes.excerpt: We had one timeout to use and both Jeremy and I we discussed it.
quotes.quote: We had one timeout to use and both Jeremy and I we discussed it. We both had the count at four, seemed a little fast, but that's sometimes how it is and that's on me. We got to do better in that situation. We still had one left, but then you're on to the next play, no matter how much you're thinking about still the previous one and already, you know, guys are thinking about boxing out and getting the ball and we knew that if they would, if they would make that shot we would go to a timeout, so I'm already thinking about that next situation then, how do we capitalize during that six seconds.
quotes.social_post: Tuomas Iisalo takes responsibility for the late game timeout management saying we got to do better in that situation.

structured.context: Coach Tuomas Iisalo explains his management of timeouts and situational play during the final moments of the game.
